name: io.github.GeiserX/genieacs-mcp
title: GenieACS
description: MCP server bridging GenieACS TR-069 ACS instances to LLMs for CPE device management

environmentVariables.name: ACS_URL
environmentVariables.description: GenieACS NBI URL, without a trailing slash

environmentVariables.name: GENIEACS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to serve only the tools that never change a device or the ACS

environmentVariables.name: GENIEACS_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names to serve; every other tool is left out

environmentVariables.name: ACS_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for one GenieACS NBI request (default 30)

environmentVariables.name: ACS_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest GenieACS NBI response the server reads, in bytes (default 4194304)
